entities.summary: Emmanuelle Cinquin, widely known as Sœur Emmanuelle, was a Catholic religious sister of both Belgian and French origins, noted for her involvement in working for the plight of the poor in Turkey and Egypt. She was honoured with Egyptian citizenship in 1991.
